title: Everything around the editor
source: Source: README.md, docs/GETTING_STARTED.md, docs/AI_TOOLS.md (Export/Import), apps/web/src/components (DatasetManager, PageGitHistory)

cards.title: Export to Vue + Vite
cards.text: Export a site as a complete Vue 3 + Vite + Tailwind v4 project and import it back, with round-trip support.

cards.title: Multiple data sources
cards.text: Static JSON, YAML and CSV files plus API endpoints, configured in `greemo.config.json`.

cards.title: Static site generation
cards.text: Build with `@greemo/cli` and deploy over SSH, to S3 or to GitHub Pages.

cards.title: Tailwind 4 styling
cards.text: Tailwind 4 styling integration, with theme colours, fonts, header and footer per site.

cards.title: Collections
cards.text: List collections with many records you can browse and filter, or Single collections for settings or a unique page.

cards.title: Page history
cards.text: See the commits that changed a page, right from the editor.
